integrity: The unbounded formula is proved by a complete fixed-face orbit analysis; finite exact checks are corroborative. No external or independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines one transposition conjugacy class on rational degree-three homology, not the full symmetric-group character, integral quotient torsion, or equivariant homotopy. Homology ranks and the rational degree-four symmetric-group action are prior results. The original 2005 paper full PDF was unavailable; the indexed author-text excerpt of its explicit Theorem 7.1 was examined.
title: Transposition eigenspaces and rational orbit homology of two-cover graph complexes
